fields.label: Recipient Phone Fieldname
fields.description: Fieldname on the reference doctype holding the WhatsApp number (e.g. mobile_no, contact_mobile)

fields.label: Or Fixed Number
fields.description: Use instead of / in addition to a fieldname, e.g. for internal alerts

fields.label: Template
fields.description: Template's Header Type must be 'Document' (and approved as such by Meta) for the PDF attachment below to actually be sent as the header.

fields.label: Provider Override
fields.description: Leave blank to use the system default provider

fields.label: Attach Document Print as PDF
fields.description: Generates a PDF of the reference document using the print format below and sends it as the template's document header.

fields.label: Print Format
fields.description: Leave blank to use the reference doctype's default print format.

fields.label: Condition (Python expression, optional)
fields.description: e.g. doc.status == 'Completed'. Leave blank to always fire.
